🇬🇧 UK Daily Briefing | Thursday, 12 November 2026

1. 💼 Budget could give skilled workers longer to find new visa sponsor
Chancellor John Healey's first budget means the highest-skilled workers who lose their jobs could get up to six months, rather than 60 days, to find a new sponsor.

2. 📈 UK economy grows at fastest rate for more than two years
The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the three months to September, according to official figures.

3. 💷 Under-25s would lose main sickness benefits under Milburn welfare plan
Under-25s would be moved off the main sickness and disability benefits and given an allowance instead under plans from Alan Milburn.

4. ⚠️ Facial recognition errors put ethnic minorities at risk of wrongful arrest
A police watchdog report warns that officers risk arresting innocent people, especially from ethnic minorities, if they treat inaccurate facial recognition data as evidence.

5. ❄️ Gas bills to rise by about 5% from December as Middle East turmoil persists
Gas bills will increase by about 5% from 1 December, Island Energy has announced.

6. 🏥 NHS figures show patients left stuck on wards for weeks awaiting discharge
Patients are being left on hospital wards for weeks after they are ready to be discharged, NHS figures show.

7. 🏪 MPs say Poundland owner extracted millions when chain was on knife-edge
MPs have accused Poundland's owner of extracting millions of pounds from the retailer when it was on a 'knife-edge'.

8. 👑 King to appear on Sir Elton John's radio show on his 78th birthday
King Charles will appear on Sir Elton John's Rocket Hour radio show on Apple Music on Saturday, his 78th birthday.

Sources: Free Movement, BBC, The Independent, Guardian, Evening Standard. Stories summarised from UK media reports. Images: Pixabay. Photos: White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons.

items.title: Budget could give skilled workers longer to find new visa sponsor
items.body: Chancellor John Healey's first budget means the highest-skilled workers who lose their jobs could get up to six months, rather than 60 days, to find a new sponsor. Salary thresholds will be reviewed in line with Migration Advisory Committee recommendations.

items.title: UK economy grows at fastest rate for more than two years
items.body: The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the three months to September, according to official figures. It is the fastest rate of growth for more than two years.

items.title: Under-25s would lose main sickness benefits under Milburn welfare plan
items.body: Under-25s would be moved off the main sickness and disability benefits and given an allowance instead under plans from Alan Milburn. He admitted the changes would not be 'pain-free'.

items.title: Facial recognition errors put ethnic minorities at risk of wrongful arrest
items.body: A police watchdog report warns that officers risk arresting innocent people, especially from ethnic minorities, if they treat inaccurate facial recognition data as evidence. Inspectors found some acted on matches from retrospective searches without enough checks.

items.title: Gas bills to rise by about 5% from December as Middle East turmoil persists
items.body: Gas bills will increase by about 5% from 1 December, Island Energy has announced. The announcement comes as turmoil in the Middle East persists.

items.title: NHS figures show patients left stuck on wards for weeks awaiting discharge
items.body: Patients are being left on hospital wards for weeks after they are ready to be discharged, NHS figures show. Such delays can lead to infections, falls and physical deterioration.

items.title: MPs say Poundland owner extracted millions when chain was on knife-edge
items.body: MPs have accused Poundland's owner of extracting millions of pounds from the retailer when it was on a 'knife-edge'. Its management will seek a two-week extension of legal protection from creditors in the high court to secure a rescue deal.

items.title: King to appear on Sir Elton John's radio show on his 78th birthday
items.body: King Charles will appear on Sir Elton John's Rocket Hour radio show on Apple Music on Saturday, his 78th birthday. The episode will see the monarch and the singer share musical memories.
